_capture.captured_at_note: stamp set by hand or CI, not Date.now()
gaps: terminal output mechanism: gateway.terminal.enabled is off on this sandbox; open/attach/input/resize/text/close params captured, but whether output arrives as an event or via terminal.text polling is unconfirmed
cron.add full shape: schedule is an object and payload is required; needs a live create with a real job to capture the row shape and schedule sub-shape

events._note: Captured from a real streamed turn against the live gateway, 2026-08-24. State rides in the PAYLOAD, never as a topic suffix.

abort.note: Captured live 2026-08-24 by aborting a real run. `aborted: true` is the signal; `stopReason` is 'rpc' (the abort's transport), NOT a word meaning cancelled — do not branch on stopReason for this.

notes: runId IS the idempotencyKey sent with chat.send (re-confirmed).
sessionKey comes back PREFIXED: sending 'ava:probe:x' yields 'agent:main:ava:probe:x'.
a normal run emits 3 lifecycle frames, so any subscriber that reloads on lifecycle MUST debounce or it refetches 3x per turn.
end.data.aborted is a real boolean — this is how an aborted run is distinguished from a completed one, which is what the Stop button needs to confirm its own effect.

exec_approvals._note: Captured 2026-08-24 by creating, listing, and resolving real approvals.

list.returns: a bare LIST of rows (not {approvals:[]}); empty comes back as an empty object

notes: NO EVENT fires while an approval is pending — verified by subscribing during a live pending request. Approvals must be POLLED; the gateway's whole topic vocabulary is agent/chat/health/tick.
exec.approval.request BLOCKS until the approval is resolved or expires; it does not return an id, so the requester cannot report its own approval.
`command` is a STRING, not argv (at /command: must be string).
Each row carries its own allowedDecisions — render from the row, do not hardcode the three values.

exec.approvals.get (PLURAL) is the POLICY file, not the pending list: {path, exists, hash, file:{version, socket, defaults, agents}}. On this sandbox defaults and agents are both empty, so nothing ever asks.

params.decision: required, one of the row's allowedDecisions

transcript._note: chat.history shapes, captured 2026-08-24 by running real turns.

inFlightRun.note: present while a run streams; `messages` still holds the PREVIOUS turn until it commits (~2-4s).

notes: NO message carries a runId. Matching a reply by runId matches nothing — the anchor is the preceding USER message's idempotencyKey.
The stored idempotencyKey is SUFFIXED by role: sending 'turn:abc' records 'turn:abc:user'. An equality test matches nothing.
content is a LIST of typed parts: [{'type':'text','text':...}].
